serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
She’s gone…
No matter what I do, that thing will never change.
Risking my own life like that…
Maybe I’m selfish, but…{{wi}} It’s scary… 
That guy that grabbed my arm last time I went there… {{wi}}I didn’t see his face, it was too dark, but his harsh voice still echoes in my nightmares.
I’m still scared that someone is looking for me, trying to silence a witness…
T-there’s nothing I can do, even if I wanted to. 
I just need to forget about it. These feelings of unease will go away with time, I’m sure of it…
